title: Structure-Informed Bounds on the Kronecker Rank of Block-Structured Matrices
summary: We derive theoretical bounds on the Kronecker rank of block-structured matrices that possess both inner and outer structure. Building on the matrix-to-tensor and tensor-to-matrix framework of Kilmer and Saibaba ($\textit{SIAM J. Matrix Anal. Appl.}$, 2022), we show that the Kronecker rank of a matrix $\mathbf{A}$ equals the dimension of the span of its distinct blocks (the $\textit{inner blockspan}$), and equals as well the dimension of the corresponding span for a permuted matrix $\mathbf{B}$ whose inner and outer structures are interchanged.
